headline: Asval criticizes housing decree for penalizing property owners and warns it will reduce supply - Crónica de Cantabria
summary: Asval has criticized the new Royal Decree-law on housing for penalizing property owners. It warns that new rental restrictions and limits may further reduce supply.
why: Spain's rental rules shape the supply of rental housing, which affects landlords' returns and tenants' access to homes.
